stem.text: The diagram shows a potentiometer circuit used to compare the electromotive forces (e.m.f.), $E_1$ and $E_2$, of two cells.
XY is a uniform resistance wire. The fixed resistor has resistance $R$.
A sliding contact is moved along the wire XY. When the sliding contact is at position P, the galvanometer reads zero.

stem.alt: Potentiometer circuit with labelled cells E1 and E2, a fixed resistor R, a wire between X and Y, a galvanometer, and a sliding contact labelled P.

stem.text: The circuit is changed so that the galvanometer reads zero when the sliding contact is at a new position to the left of P.
Which change could have been made to the circuit?

A.text: The wire XY was replaced with one of lower resistance.
